epic.title: Student Profile Feature Integration
epic.body: Integrates existing academic, financial, and administrative features into the Student profile, providing students with direct access to their own schedules, attendance, fees, and performance data as implemented in the current codebase.

features.title: Student Academic & Schedule Access
features.body: Direct access for students to view their personal class timetables, homework assignments, and study materials.

stories.title: Personal Timetable Interface
stories.body: Display the student's own weekly and daily class schedules including subject, teacher, and room details.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Show timeline of periods for the logged-in student's class.
Toggle: Switch between Daily and Weekly view modes.
Detail: Display Subject, Teacher Name, Room/Lab number, and Time range.

stories.title: Homework and Study Material Access
stories.body: Provide a centralized view for students to track assigned homework and access learning resources shared by teachers.
acceptanceCriteria: Homework: List assignments with status (Pending/Completed), due dates, and descriptions.
Materials: Access categorized resources (PDF, PPT, Links) mapped to the student's subjects.
Download: Enable viewing or downloading of attached academic files.

stories.title: Student Academic Data Service
stories.body: API endpoints to serve timetable, homework, and materials specifically for the authenticated student's class and section.
acceptanceCriteria: GET: Fetch timetable records based on the student's classId.
GET: Retrieve homework and materials filtered by the student's enrollment and subject mapping.
Security: Ensure data is strictly scoped to the authenticated student's identity.

features.title: Student Fee & Payment Tracking
features.body: Allows students to monitor their fee status, installment plans, and transaction history.

stories.title: Personal Fee Status and Ledger
stories.body: Display the student's fee summary, including total paid and outstanding balances.
acceptanceCriteria: Summary: Show cards for Total Fee, Paid Amount, and Balance Due.
Ledger: List all fee installments with their respective due dates and payment status.
Receipts: Provide a list of previous transactions with the option to view receipt details.

stories.title: Student Financial Record API
stories.body: Backend service to serve personalized financial data and payment status for the logged-in student.
acceptanceCriteria: GET: Retrieve the fee structure and installment schedule for the student.
GET: Fetch chronological payment history and transaction metadata.
Validation: Restrict financial data access to the specific student owner.

features.title: Attendance Tracking & Leave Application
features.body: Enables students to track their own attendance trends and apply for leaves directly through their profile.

stories.title: Attendance Analytics and Calendar
stories.body: Provide students with a monthly calendar view and percentage-based summary of their attendance.
acceptanceCriteria: Calendar: Monthly grid with status indicators (Present/Absent/Leave/Holiday).
Summary: Card showing 'Attendance Percentage' and total days missed.
Trend: Visual progress bar representing current attendance health.

stories.title: Student Leave Request Management
stories.body: Functionality for students to submit leave applications and track approval status from their teachers.
acceptanceCriteria: Create: Form to apply for leave with dates and reason.
List: History of leave requests with status (Pending/Approved/Rejected).
Review: View teacher feedback/comments on processed leave requests.

stories.title: Attendance & Leave Lifecycle API
stories.body: API endpoints to manage student attendance logs and leave application workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: GET: Fetch daily attendance status for the studentId.
POST/GET: Create and list leave applications for the student.
Calculations: Serve aggregate attendance percentages for the student profile.

features.title: Exams, Performance & Conduct
features.body: Access to examination schedules, performance results, and behavioral remarks.

stories.title: Exam Results and Grades Interface
stories.body: Display detailed academic results, including subject-wise marks and overall grades for completed exams.
acceptanceCriteria: Results: Card view showing total marks, percentage, and grade for each exam.
Breakdown: Expandable section for subject-wise marks and performance rank.
Schedule: View upcoming exam schedules and subject lists.

stories.title: Conduct and Remark History
stories.body: View behavioral feedback and remarks posted by teachers regarding school conduct.
acceptanceCriteria: Timeline: Chronological list of remarks (Academic, Discipline, Attitude).
Details: View authoring teacher and remark content.

stories.title: Academic Performance & Conduct API
stories.body: API to serve result data and behavioral logs for the student profile.
acceptanceCriteria: GET: Retrieve exam schedules and graded results for the studentId.
GET: Retrieve all conduct remarks mapped to the student.
